query:
SELECT user_id, COALESCE(SUM(
                COALESCE(
                    total::float8,
                    (input_tokens::float8 / 1000000.0) * $4
                        + (output_tokens::float8 / 1000000.0) * $5
                )
            ), 0)::float8 AS "usd!"
            FROM ai_usage
            WHERE user_id = ANY($1)
              AND created_at >= $2
              AND created_at < $3
              AND feature <> ALL($6)
            GROUP BY user_id
